notes: `לְבַדּוֹ` → *alone* is the chapter's only multi-source unit; the preposition and its construct noun meet rule 30's one-rendering condition, headed on `בַּד`, and the suffix is no part of the fusion, so it is `unrepresented` as that rule directs.
The substantival participle's unit is discontinuous around *alone* under rule 25.
